archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with controlled Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) accents
emotional_tone: Cinematic, Professional, Cutting-edge AI Lab, Magical yet highly technical

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for major marketing sections. Use p-6 for dashboard cards.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetric bento grid with gap-8. Prevent perfect symmetry.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. gap-4 to gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
layout_and_spacing.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl or 2xl on top nav and major marketing cards. 1px inner stroke border-white/10.
layout_and_spacing.max_width: max-w-7xl mx-auto for pages, 100% width for dashboard workspace.

buttons.primary: Gradient background (purple to blue) with hover scale (scale-105) and drop shadow glow (drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(99,102,241,0.5)]). Text color must be pure white.
buttons.secondary: Glass style: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 text-white transition-all.

cards.marketing: Glassmorphism, deep background, 1px white/10 border. Overlay subtle noise/grain texture.
cards.dashboard: Flat dark bg (#09090B), 1px border-white/5, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-white/15 transition-all.

inputs.style: Dark background (bg-black/50), border-white/10, focus:border-purple-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-500 text-white placeholder:text-gray-500.

video_timeline.description: Custom visual component for the Prompt Result page. Must feel like a premium video editor.
video_timeline.style: Horizontal or stacked list. Each scene card should have a timestamp (mono font), thumbnail (or abstract placeholder), and AI metadata tags (cyan/purple outlines). Active scene should have a cyan left-border highlight.

tabs.style: Use Shadcn tabs but heavily customized. bg-white/5 p-1 rounded-lg. Active tab: bg-white/10 text-white shadow-sm. Inactive tab: text-secondary hover:text-white.

motion_and_effects.hover: All interactive elements must have hover state transitions (duration-200 or 300).
motion_and_effects.glow: Use drop-shadows strategically on the primary CTA and key data points (e.g. Credit Balance). DO NOT overuse.
motion_and_effects.entrance: Use framer-motion for staggered fade-in up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) on lists and grid items.

brand.description: VideosToPrompt Logo (Purple-Blue Gradient play icon with wordmark)

hero_demo.description: Cinematic Cyberpunk city shot for video demo placeholder

feature_cinematic.description: Professional cameraman in moody red/warm lighting
feature_cinematic.placement: Feature section 'Turn Any Video Into Powerful AI Prompts'

abstract_tech.placement: API Docs background, or prompt generation loading state background

testing_requirements.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs, video upload dropzone, export buttons, model tabs) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure 'lucide-react' for all iconography.
Use Tailwind CSS for all layout and styling. Do not write custom CSS unless strictly for animations/masks that Tailwind cannot handle.
Implement the Layout for authenticated pages using a collapsible sidebar (Shadcn Sidebar pattern or custom flex layout).
For the Video Upload section, create a large, dashed-border dropzone (bg-white/5 border-dashed border-white/20 hover:border-purple-500 transition-colors).

For the Prompt Result page, create a striking two-column or stacked layout: Left side (or top) shows the Video Timeline visualization, Right side (or bottom) shows the Model-specific Prompts (Veo/Sora/Kling/etc.) using Tabs.
Apply 'Outfit' font to all h1, h2, h3 tags and 'Manrope' to body text. Ensure they are loaded via Google Fonts in index.html.
Do NOT use placeholder text for missing logos; strictly use the provided logo URL.
Implement the 'Credit Balance' card in the dashboard sidebar or top header with a subtle cyan or purple glow to draw attention to it.
Ensure the hero section on the landing page has a deep background with a subtle, animated radial gradient behind the text to make the 'Turn Any Video Into Powerful AI Prompts' headline pop.
